component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() m.clock = CreateObject("roTimespan") m.seq = 0 m.samples = 0 m.lastState = "" m.items = {} m.list = invalid perList = ["key:Right", "key:Right", "key:Right", "key:Left", "key:Down", "key:Down", "key:Down", "key:Down_Down", "hold:Down", "act:jump0", "key:Up", "hold:Right", "act:animate7", "act:jump1", "act:skip", "key:Down", "act:noskip"] m.steps = [] for each id in ["GF", "GW", "PF", "PW"] m.steps.push("list:" + id) m.steps.append(perList) end for m.steps.push("done") m.step = -1 for each id in ["GF", "GW", "PF", "PW"] l = m.top.findNode(id) l.content = makeContent() for each f in ["itemFocused", "itemUnfocused", "currFocusRow", "currFocusColumn", "scrollingStatus", "vertFocusDirection", "horizFocusDirection"] if l.hasField(f) then l.observeField(f, "onListField") end for end for for each id in ["GF", "GW", "PF", "PW"] rec("info", "fields " + id + " " + fieldList(m.top.findNode(id), ["skipFocusAnimations", "vertFocusAnimationStyle", "horizFocusAnimationStyle", "numRows", "numColumns", "focusRow", "focusColumn", "vertFocusDirection", "horizFocusDirection", "wrapDividerHeight"])) end for m.top.findNode("sampler").observeField("fire", "onSample") m.top.findNode("stepTimer").observeField("fire", "onStep") m.top.findNode("sampler").control = "start" m.top.findNode("stepTimer").control = "start" end sub
function makeContent() as object root = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for i = 0 to 14 c = root.createChild("ContentNode") c.title = "I" + StrI(i).trim() c.shortDescriptionLine1 = "I" + StrI(i).trim() end for return root end function
function now() as string return StrI(m.clock.TotalMilliseconds()).trim() end function
sub rec(kind as string, body as string) m.seq = m.seq + 1 s = StrI(m.seq).trim() while len(s) < 4 s = "0" + s end while print "PROBE|" + s + "|" + now() + "|" + kind + "|" + body end sub
function num(v as dynamic) as string return Str(Int(v * 100 + 0.5) / 100).trim() end function
function valStr(v as dynamic) as string t = type(v) if t = "roBoolean" or t = "Boolean" if v then return "true" else return "false" else if t = "roInt" or t = "Integer" or t = "roFloat" or t = "Float" or t = "roDouble" or t = "Double" return num(v) else if t = "roString" or t = "String" return v else if t = "roArray" out = "[" for each e in v out = out + valStr(e) + "," end for return out + "]" end if return "<" + t + ">" end function
function fieldList(node as object, keys as object) as string out = "" for each k in keys if node.hasField(k) out = out + k + "=" + valStr(node.getField(k)) + " " else out = out + k + "=<absent> " end if end for return out end function
function itemLog(text as string) as boolean rec("item", text) return true end function
function registerItem(info as object) as boolean m.items[info.name] = info.node return true end function
sub onListField(ev as object) rec("lf", ev.getRoSGNode().id + "." + ev.getField() + "=" + valStr(ev.getData())) end sub
sub onSample() m.samples = m.samples + 1 if m.list = invalid then return l = m.list state = "fr=" + num(l.currFocusRow) + " fc=" + num(l.currFocusColumn) + " ss=" + valStr(l.scrollingStatus) if l.subtype() = "MarkupGrid" nodes = "" for i = 0 to 14 n = m.items["I" + StrI(i).trim()] if n <> invalid and n.focusPercent > 0 nodes = nodes + " " + StrI(i).trim() + "@" + num(n.focusPercent) end if end for state = state + " fp" + nodes end if if state <> m.lastState m.lastState = state rec("frame", state) end if end sub
sub onStep() m.step = m.step + 1 action = m.steps[m.step] rec("step", StrI(m.step).trim() + " " + action) timer = m.top.findNode("stepTimer") timer.duration = 2 if action = "done" rec("info", "samples=" + StrI(m.samples).trim()) print "PROBE|done" m.top.probeExit = true return end if parts = action.split(":") if parts[0] = "list" if m.list <> invalid then m.list.visible = false m.list = m.top.findNode(parts[1]) m.list.visible = true m.items = {} m.lastState = "" m.list.setFocus(true) rec("act", "focus " + parts[1] + " " + fieldList(m.list, ["itemFocused", "currFocusRow"])) else if parts[0] = "key" print "PROBE|await|" + parts[1] else if parts[0] = "hold" print "PROBE|await|Hold" + parts[1] timer.duration = 3.5 else if parts[0] = "act" a = parts[1] if a = "jump0" m.list.jumpToItem = 0 else if a = "jump1" m.list.jumpToItem = 1 else if a = "animate7" m.list.animateToItem = 7 else if a = "skip" m.list.skipFocusAnimations = true else if a = "noskip" m.list.skipFocusAnimations = false end if rec("act", a + " " + fieldList(m.list, ["itemFocused", "currFocusRow", "skipFocusAnimations"])) end if timer.control = "start" end sub
